Town.reason: The Game/import-side producer recognizes legacy Town records, but the accepted public export advertises no Town capability and contains no Town projector or canonical public Town records.

Waypoint.reason: The Game/import-side producer recognizes legacy Waypoint records, but the public export has no Waypoint capability/projector and publishes no canonical public Waypoint records.

Area.reason: Area is an accepted canonical geography concept and is permitted by the Game-to-Atlas capability envelope, but no authored Area dataset or public Area exporter is present in current main.

Subarea.reason: Subarea is an accepted canonical geography concept with parent Area semantics, but no current authored Subarea dataset or public exporter is present.

Zone.reason: Zone is an accepted overlapping rules-boundary concept and public zones are permitted by the capability envelope, but current Atlas source export has no Zone capability or records.

POI.reason: POI is only a candidate public semantic family in the contract envelope; no current Game-owned POI source model, projector, capability, or records were found.

conclusion: Atlas may prepare fail-closed consumers and UI for these families, but current FullWorld publication must not display any Town, Waypoint, Area, Subarea, Zone, or POI as authenticated factual data.
